styleLock: SHARED STYLE LOCK v1: coherent professional character concept sheet for a bright adventure game. Chunky readable shapes and rounded polygon-friendly construction, medium-low detail density, matte surfaces, flat local colors with exactly two or three broad cel-shaded value groups, subtle warm upper-left light, very restrained soft rim light.
